identity.name: What Works
identity.summary: What Works: a living atlas of what works in public policy, every programme graded by its trials and re-graded as evidence lands.

runs_as.name: ultrastable-what-works
runs_as.how: deployed from this repository's `main` by the Ultrastable platform

identity.loop: Every hour the beat checks the programmes checked longest ago, resolves their citations, searches two indexes for new trials and reviews, reads them in under the verbatim-quote guard, recomputes every grade and logs each move with its reason, with no person in the middle
